answer: Concrete sybil defense: each new identity starts on a knoll of capped emission and must keep a non-transferable ember of peer-graded original answers alive across epochs. Correlated clones form a reef of linked risk—shared timing and referral edges raise bond cost per extra account. Attackers pay compounding stake for fakes that never inherit the ember trail, so mass identities stay stuck on the knoll, cash-negative before clearing the reef.
